Patient Controlled Analgesia is an analgesia method whereby the patient controls the amount of analgesics received within certain predefined constraints. 

Typically this is by using a computerised pump with a patient activated trigger to deliver predetermined dose within a set minimum interval time.

Commonly used opioids for PCA include morphine and fentanyl.

+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                      | **Fentanyl**                                                                                                                                                                                    | **Morphine **                                                                                           |

| **Typical Dose **    | 20mcg                                                                                                                                                                                           | 1mg                                                                                                     |
+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Typical Lockout ** | 5min                                                                                                                                                                                            | 5min                                                                                                    |
+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Onset**            | Rapid \~5min                                                                                                                                                                                    |  Slow \~30min                                                                                           |
+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Offset **          | Rapid 5-20min                                                                                                                                                                                   | Slow                                                                                                    |
+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Metabolites**      | Nil active                                                                                                                                                                                      | Active metabolites, ↑risk of accumulation in renal failure                                              |
+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Side Effects **    | Similar side effect profiles, side effect profile more significant for morphine given its slower onset, active metabolites and increased risk of accumulation in renal failure.                                                                                                                           |
+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Notes**            | Rapid onset good for fast control of pain, however rapid offset requires consistent dosing to maintain an effective dose and can result is regular trough particularly during rest / overnight  | Although dose relatively low the dosing lockout period significantly shorter than time to peak effect.  |
|                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                                                         |
|                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                 | This allows 4-5 doses to be administered prior to peak effect.                                          |
+----------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
